The Metropolitan Association of Psi Upsilon, which
embraces New York City and the nearby areas of
Connecticut, Long Island, and New Jersey arranged
to have its Annual Founders' Day Dinner serve as
the closing feature of the Fall meeting of the Execu
tive Council. The date was November 21, 1976.

Nearly one hundred Brothers in Psi Upsilon attend
ed this affair held at the Chemists Club. In addition
to the Alumni Brothers who attended there was a

goodly representation of the active members of the
Lambda and Delta Chapters. The latter groups spent
most of the evening in a contest as to which one could
do better with the Songs of Psi Upsilon. This proved
to be an enlivening contribution to what was surely
a most enjoyable
gathering of Psi Upsilon Brothers.
As has been customary for some years the dinner
was preceded by a Hospitality Hour where the as
sembled Brothers had the opportunity to reminisce
with some of their pals of yesteryear and to meet
others who appeared for the first time, or not for some
years. It also gave the Alumni Brothers an opportunity
to meet and chat with undergraduate Brothers. It was
the consensus of opinion that the new Brothers were
indeed worthy of their peers and predecessors.

companied with a selection of fine wine which was
